parent_objective: run one fixed-budget train/eval seed per profile as plumbing smoke
blocked_by: full 12-profile runtime smoke has passed, but no fixed-budget training/eval plumbing has been run
supersedes: jumping directly to three-seed profile pilot without one-seed smoke

public_gates: M1495 must run exactly one fixed-budget training seed per selected profile
M1495 must use the same training budget, optimizer policy, and eval seed block for all profiles
M1495 must report completion and finite selected metrics only as plumbing evidence
M1495 must block promotion private holdout profile ranking and self-ID claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not tune one profile from results
do not claim architecture ranking or recurrent self-identification from one seed

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether all 12 go/no-go profiles can complete one matched fixed-budget train/eval run
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: plumbing-only public smoke; no promotion, private holdout, profile-ranking, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if any profile seed run fails
stop if selected metrics are non-finite
stop if private holdout or promotion is used
fallback_plan: route to profile-control repair if a config family fails
route to one-seed result audit if all profile runs complete

admission_evidence: M1494 runtime smoke passed for all 12 refreshed configs
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1495 is one-seed plumbing only; any trends are not self-ID evidence.
history_necessity_tests: one-seed L2 normal versus current-tiled and L3 online versus reset data may be logged, but interpretation is deferred to audit
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: one fixed-budget public seed per profile.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Treat one-seed trends as plumbing diagnostics only, whether positive or negative.
allowed_claims: M1495 tests fixed-budget profile training/eval plumbing
no promotion, corpus export, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The refreshed 12-profile go/no-go matrix can complete one matched fixed-budget train/eval seed per profile with finite metrics.
failure_criteria: private holdout promotion profile-specific tuning or actor-input change occurs

commands.name: one_seed_smoke
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m autodrift.corrected_profile_pilot --config-dir configs/paper_route_corrected_profiles --config-glob 'm1207_*.json' --run-dir runs/m1495_go_no_go_profile_one_seed_smoke --training-seed-base 149500 --seed-offsets 0 --eval-seed-base 149600 --eval-episodes 32 --device cpu

decision_rule: M1495 passes if the one-seed fixed-budget profile smoke completes all 12 profile runs with finite metrics and no promotion/private holdout.
